effect-quote: Her [Axe Kick] shattered the skull of the invisible [Rogue] and the Garuda took wing, hunting for her next target.

holder-quote: Sure enough, Joseph had lined up. This time—Rea dove as he shouted.
effect-quote: Joseph’s eyes widened as the Garuda dropped and her clawed foot hit the ball. The impact was like a thunderclap in the air.

holder-quote: Don’t hit her harder than that, Mera!
effect-quote: She baited Erin forwards, flipped, and brought both legs down on Erin’s crossed arms.

holder-quote: She didn’t have her [Axe Kick], but she performed one anyways.
